(C. & S.B.) Office Notes
Date APRIL 13, 1931.
SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE
C. & S. REGISTRY
No. S. E. D. 2952
Date 7 . 4 . 31

Formation of Narcotic Section

Location
Office space consisting of two rooms in a second storey flat at No. 1 B. Henan Road has been secured and is ready for occupation.

Personnel
The estimates for this section allow for the following:-
1. Foreign detective Inspector
2. Chinese detective Sergeants
1. Chinese 4th class clerk

S. I. Papp has already been transferred and entered on duties connected with the Section and Insp. Perkins is available when the necessary arrangements have been made with O.C. i/c Traffic Dept. for his transfer.

This arrangement will not exceed the estimates except in a departmental sense.

It is recommended that C.D.S. 76 (Louza), C.D.C. 1 (Headquarters Crime Branch) and C.D.C. 175 (Hongkew) be transferred to the newly-formed section as the nucleus of a Chinese staff. This arrangement will not quite conform to the estimate but at least three Chinese detectives are needed to commence the section and the extra member of the staff can be taken from another section of Headquarters Staff. The detectives enumerated above have proved to be acquainted with the ramifications of the narcotic problem in Shanghai.

Mr. Tsung Sung Pao, 3rd Grade clerk now attached to Crime Branch Head-

尽管切断了某些联系，但如果能提供激励措施给线人，预计情报来源不会匮乏。然而，目前法院对鸦片和毒品罪犯普遍采用的惩罚方法确实带来了一个困难。以前法院会处以高额罚款，其中捐赠给警方的20%实际上足以支付线人费用并确保定期获得情报来源。近来，法院量刑更为严厉，判处罪犯监禁。因此，可能不时需要申请资金以支付线人费用，但建议在该组工作实际展开且事态证明设立基金绝对必要之前，暂不设立专项基金。

（印：SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE C. & S. D. REGISTRY No. S. D. D. 2952 Date 7 / 4 / 31 Narcotic Section Station,）

REPORT
Date April 5, 1931

Subject (in full) Further suggestions for the organization of the Narcotic
Section.

Made by S. I. Papp Forwarded by Supt. Yorke

5. Reports from Stations
With a view to enabling the Section to keep complete
records of the number of raids carried out by the Municipal
Police, and of the arrests and seizures made as a result, it is
requested, that copies of all reports concerning the matters
given below be forwarded to The Superintendent, Crime Branch
Headquarters with the least possible delay:-
1. Copies of reports of the occurrence Book re all
raids, carried out by the Station concerned,
persons arrested and seizures made, giving the
exact quantity of narcotic seized in each raid.
2. Copies of all arrest reports and diaries concern-
ing narcotic cases.

6. Assisting Stations in narcotic cases
In certain cases of arrests and seizures of powders,
which are suspected to contain narcotics and when the laboratory
of the Health Department is not available, the Section could
assist the Stations in making a decision in the particular case.
In such cases the Section could give an opinion, whether a certain
substance contains narcotics or not. This opinion would be based
on a simple test of the substance in question.

S. Papp
S. I.

（左侧批注：Agreed Wd Harrison R/M）
D.C. (C. & S.B.)
This would defeat the object
of de-centralization as now intended & further enlarge
the Narcotic Section into a possibly unwieldy size not the
intention.
R.H.Y.

（印：上海公共租界工部局警务处 C. & S. D. 档案室 编号 S. D. D. 2952 日期 31年4月7日 缉毒组 捕房，）

报告
日期 1931年4月5日

主题（全称） 关于缉毒组组织的进一步建议。

由 华籍副巡官 (S. I.) 法普 (Papp) 提出 经 约克警司 (Supt. Yorke) 转呈

5. 各捕房的报告
为使本组能够完整记录工部局警务处执行的突击搜查次数，以及由此产生的逮捕和缴获情况，特请求将涉及以下事项的所有报告副本尽快送交总部刑事科警司：
1. 有关相关捕房执行的所有突击搜查、逮捕人员及缴获物品的发生簿 (Occurrence Book) 报告副本，需注明每次突击搜查中缴获毒品的确切数量。
2. 所有涉及毒品案件的逮捕报告和日记副本。

6. 在毒品案件中协助各捕房
在某些逮捕和缴获粉末的案件中，若怀疑含有毒品且卫生处实验室无法使用时，本组可协助各捕房就该特定案件做出决定。在此类情况下，本组可就某种物质是否含有毒品提供意见。该意见将基于对该物质的简单测试。

S. 法普
华籍副巡官 (S. I.)

（左侧批注：同意 Wd Harrison R/M）
副警务处处长 (D.C.) (刑事与特别课)
这将违背目前预期的去中心化目标，并进一步扩大缉毒组的规模，使其可能变得过于庞大，这并非本意。
R.H.Y.
4月7日

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.

REPORT
Narcotic Section Station,
Date April 2, 1931
Subject (in full) Suggestions for the organisation of the Narcotic Section.
Made by S. I. Papp Forwarded by Supt. Yorke

1. Duties of the Section
The principal duty of the Narcotic Section is to check as far as possible the illicit sale and use of opium and narcetic drugs in and their smuggling into the International Settlement.
The duties of the Section will be specifically as follows:-
1. To investigate and report regarding firms, hongs or persons who are engaged in the contraband traffic of opium and narcetic drugs in the Settlement.
（批：With the approval of the staff. Yorke）
2. To investigate and raid opium selling and smoking dens in the Settlement.
3. To enquire into anonymous informations received regarding narcotics.
4. To bring to notice any resolutions passed by the League of Nations with regard to the narcotic situation in the Far East.
5. To report on the extent of the illicit traffic in the Settlement, the French Concession and in Chinese territory.
6. To report on seizures made by the Maritime Customs and the administrations of adjoining areas.
7. To make monthly reports.
The Section will keep the following records:-
1. Lists of suspected smugglers and peddlers in narcotic drugs.
2. Lists of suspected addresses.
3. Lists of seizures made by the S.M.P. as regards:-
A. Quantity

缉毒组的主要职责是尽可能遏制鸦片及麻醉药物在国际租界内的非法销售和使用，以及防止其走私进入国际租界。
本组的具体职责如下：
1. 调查并报告租界内从事鸦片及麻醉药物违禁贸易的公司、商行或个人。
（批：经职员批准。约克）
2. 调查并突击搜查租界内的鸦片销售和吸食窝点。
3. 查核收到的关于毒品的匿名举报。
4. 提请注意国际联盟通过的关于远东毒品局势的任何决议。
5. 报告租界、法租界及中国领土内非法贸易的范围。
6. 报告海关及邻近地区行政当局所进行的缴获行动。
7. 编制月度报告。
本组将保存以下记录：
1. 涉嫌走私者和毒品小贩名单。
2. 涉嫌地址名单。
3. 上海公共租界工部局警务处 (S.M.P.) 缴获物品清单，涉及：
A. 数量

Subject (in full) Suggestions for the organisation of the Narcotic Section.
Made by Inspector Perkins Forwarded by Supt. Yorke

（批：Yes Please）

The following are the duties of the Section:-
1. To investigate and raid opium selling and
smoking dens in co-operation with stations
concerned.
2. To investigate and as far as possible prevent
smuggling of narcotics into the Settlement.
3. To inquire into anonymous letters received
regarding narcotics.
4. To make monthly reports.

Staff
In order to carry out the above duties the Section
would require the following staff:-
One Foreign Inspector
One Foreign Sub-Inspector
Four Chinese Sub-Inspectors
One Chinese First Class Clerk

It must be understood that this staff will be sufficient
only on the condition that working in close co-operation with
stations concerned will be satisfactory.

（批：We must wait & see how things go）

J. S. Perkins.
Inspector

REPORT
Date December 8, 1930.
Subject (in full) Re Opium Preventive Squad.
Made by Inspr. O. B. Perkins. Forwarded by

Sir,
With reference to attached, I beg to report that during
the last three years very little opium has been seized with
the exception of approximately 685 lbs. which was undoubtedly
in transit through the Settlement having come from the
River boats tied up at the Hongkew and Wayside Wharf.
Owing to the smallness of the Squad which consists of
one Foreign Inspector and one Chinese Clerk, under the
Officer i/c of the Traffic Branch, with only the assistance
of other members of the Traffic Office when raiding, and
the firm belief that very little-if any-opium is now stored
in the Settlement, most of the time has been taken up in
raiding and obtaining information of opium smoking dens.
Re No. 1. The only correspondence received is an
occasional report from Headquarters calling for inquiries
which after enquiries are made is returned to Headquarters
and a few personal anonymous letters which are usually useless
and not filed. The records kept are Court records of evidence
and file cards as per attached. A number is given to the
Court record and entered on the file card.
No. 2. This is not done only in very special cases,
then by report form together with Court record.
No. 3. The local side of the matter is kept in touch
with by informers. Practically no information is received
regarding other parts of the World, other than that which
occasionally comes from Headquarters, appears in newspapers
or from the Dollar Company. In reference to smuggling of

阁下，
关于附件内容，谨报告如下：在过去三年中，除了大约685磅鸦片无疑是从停靠在虹口和路边码头 (Wayside Wharf) 的河运船只上过境租界而被查获外，极少查获鸦片。
由于稽查队规模很小，仅由一名外籍巡官和一名华籍文员组成，隶属于交通处负责人管辖，仅在突击搜查时得到交通处其他成员的协助，且坚信租界内现在几乎—if any—没有储存鸦片，大部分时间都用于突击搜查和获取鸦片吸食窝点的情报。
关于第1点。收到的唯一信件是总部偶尔要求查询的报告，经查询后退回总部，以及一些通常无用且未归档的个人匿名信件。保存的记录是法庭证据记录和如附件所示的档案卡片。法庭记录会被赋予一个编号并录入档案卡片。
第2点。此事仅在非常特殊的情况下进行，届时通过报告形式连同法庭记录一并提交。
第3点。本地方面的事务通过线人保持联系。除了偶尔来自总部、见于报纸或来自“Dollar Company”（原文不清，可能指某机构或公司）的信息外， practically 没有收到关于世界其他地区的情报。关于走私的

Through information received from this company, it has
been possible to keep in close touch with a very powerful
and well organised gang of smugglers who operate between
here and the United States. Several of these smugglers
reside in the Settlement, but as their business is carried
on outside Settlement limits, it is extremely difficult

No. 4. 20% of Court fines are allowed by the Special
District Court in all opium cases. The fines are paid
into the Court and the 20% is applied for by the station
concerned and on receipt of same is forwarded to Headquarters
(Pay Office).
No. 5. Informers usually get 10% of the fines and where
no fines are paid, from the Special Fund. As it is thought
advisable to keep informers away from the Traffic Office,
they are usually paid through the Clerk, Wong Zoen Ding,
who is attached to the Preventive Squad.
No. 6. Through informers generally. With the exception
of the gang which is active on the Dollar vessels, there
are practically no suspects.
No. 7. Staff:- One Foreign Detective Inspector, One Russian
Detective Sub-Inspector, One 1st Class Clerk, two Cantonese
Detective Sergeants, three Chinese Detective Sergeants.

通过该公司轮船将鸦片从上海运往美国
的盎司装听子。
通过从该公司获得的情报，得以与一个势力强大且组织严密的走私团伙保持密切联系，该团伙在上海与美国之间活动。这些走私者中有数人居住在租界内，但由于其业务在租界范围之外进行，因此极难获取实施逮捕所需的情报。
第4项。特区法院在所有鸦片案件中允许提取法庭罚金的20%。罚金缴入法院，相关分署申请这20%的款项，收到后转交总局（支付股）。
第5项。线人通常获得罚金的10%，若未缴纳罚金，则从特别基金中支付。鉴于认为宜使线人远离交通科办公室，他们通常经由隶属于侦缉队的职员 Wong Zoen Ding（音译）领取酬金。
第6项。通常通过线人获取情报。除了在“Dollar”轮船上活动的团伙外，实际上没有嫌疑人。
第7项。人员：一名外籍侦探督察，一名俄籍侦探副督察，一名一等职员，两名广东籍侦探巡长，三名华籍侦探巡长。
家具：三张写字台，一个由顶盖和四个抽屉组成的文件柜，一台打字机和六把办公椅。
